# TrustLock

AI escrow for freelancers. The client funds a milestone (PayPal authorize, funds
held), the freelancer submits deliverables, an AI verifier checks the work
against the brief, and the payment releases automatically on approval. Disputes
freeze the escrow for human review.

PayPal AI Hackathon 2026 entry. Demo runs on mock payments.

Key routes:
- / — marketing landing page
- /dashboard — milestone list and creation
- /escrow/[id] — the escrow flow: fund, submit, verify, release, dispute
- /disputes — human review queue

Core modules:
- lib/paypal/paypal-client.ts — PayPal interface + mock (sandbox mapping documented)
- lib/verifier/verifier.ts — AI verifier interface + mock (LLM slot documented)
- lib/db/db.ts — JSON prototype store
